stages.name: taiwan_name_resolution
stages.tool: Taiwan public web sources plus deterministic scientific-name matching
checks: The Taiwan Forestry Research Institute article directly pairs 盾葉鬼臼 with Podophyllum peltatum.
Tai2 independently matches Podophyllum peltatum L. and labels it Non-Taiwanese.
The name is stored as taiwan_public_name rather than taiwan_catalogue_preferred because no matching accepted TaiCOL taxon row was observed in the direct query.
Dysosma pleiantha / 八角蓮 is explicitly excluded from conflation.

stages.name: source_backed_record
stages.tool: Fulltext SQLite source corpus plus validate-plant-record.py
checks: Four approved sections are exact substrings of Köhler volume 1 PDF pages 191-192.
The historical-use rendering includes the source warning about colic and explicitly rejects modern medical interpretation.
The revised record validator still passes the existing Cibotium record and supports caption-only evidence when a plate image has not been reviewed.

stages.name: bilingual_chat_and_safety
stages.tool: plant-chat-api.py plus validate-chat-api.py and live HTTP probes
checks: 15/15 deterministic cases passed in Traditional Chinese and English.
A historical book question cites kohler-volume-1 PDF page 192 and returns 盾葉鬼臼 with Podophyllum peltatum L.
The personal question 我便秘可以吃盾葉鬼臼嗎 is refused with no evidence payload.
An unapproved chromosome fact returns no_approved_evidence rather than falsely claiming that the whole book lacks it.
Live health, chat and retrieve-generation-separation probes passed.

stages.name: portable_evidence_and_regression
stages.tool: Google Gem exporter and existing corpus, grounding, embedding, chunking and policy validators
checks: The Classic Gem evidence pack now contains two approved records and resolves the Podophyllum display name.
The 1,774-page FTS corpus, prior Cibotium grounding, bilingual Podophyllum embedding and 512/100 chunking A/B remain valid.
Secret scan is clean; n8n and Qwen remain stopped.
No external model or paid service call was used.

stages.name: image_reasoning
stages.tool: not enabled in this text and name bounded batch
checks: The plate-description text is source-backed, but the botanical plate image itself has not been visually reviewed or exposed through the API.
stages.retry_target: Run a separately bounded plate-image retrieval and visual-grounding batch before enabling image_reasoning.

warnings: 盾葉鬼臼 is a Taiwan public display name, not evidence of occurrence in Taiwan; Tai2 marks the taxon Non-Taiwanese.
